title: The 'Dead' Star That Sent a Signal 50 Years After It Vanished
hook: A star went dark in 1970—then in 2023, its signal came back, impossibly, from a region of space where nothing should exist.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines a classic mystery (a vanished star) with an impossible return—creates high curiosity and eerie tension.

title: The Asteroid That 'Froze' Time for 3 Seconds Across Earth
hook: When this asteroid passed Earth, every atomic clock on the planet stopped for three seconds—and no one knows why.
why_this_can_go_viral: Mixes a tangible threat with a mind-bending effect on time—highly shareable and puzzling.

title: The Classified 'Project' That Dug 40 km Into Earth—And Found Nothing
hook: A secret Cold War project drilled deeper than any before, but the hole was sealed and the team vanished.
why_this_can_go_viral: Taps into conspiracy and forbidden knowledge—drilling to the center of Earth is a classic dark mystery.

title: The 'Extinction Event' That Left Fossilized Screams in Rock
hook: A mass die-off 250 million years ago preserved the last moments of life in stone—and the pattern repeats every 30 million years.
why_this_can_go_viral: Visceral horror of preserved screams combines with a recurring pattern—triggers fear and fascination.

title: The Star That 'Screamed' in Radio Waves Before Exploding
hook: Just before a supernova, a star emitted a radio shriek that was picked up by a Soviet telescope—the signal was human-like.
why_this_can_go_viral: Anthropomorphic horror (star screaming) plus a secret Soviet connection—dark and mysterious.

title: The 'Dark Matter' That Caused a Galaxy to Rotate Backward
hook: A galaxy spins opposite to its own dark matter halo—meaning the invisible stuff is moving independently, like a ghost driving a car.
why_this_can_go_viral: Visual and intuitive paradox (ghost driving a car) makes a complex concept instantly engaging.

title: The Fermi Paradox 'Solution': We're in a Simulation That's About to Crash
hook: New mathematical models suggest our universe shows signs of a computational limit—and the simulation may be degrading.
why_this_can_go_viral: Existential dread + cutting-edge theory—people love simulation content and the idea of an impending 'crash'.

title: The Classified 'Space Mirror' That Reflected Earth's Own Destruction
hook: In 1966, a secret satellite reflected an image back to Earth: our planet exploding. Twenty years later, the tape was found.

title: The 'Void' That Swallowed a Supercluster—And Sent Back Nothing
hook: The Hercules-Corona Borealis Great Wall, 10 billion light-years across, disappeared from our telescopes—something erased it.
why_this_can_go_viral: Scale + disappearance creates awe and terror—what could erase a supercluster?

title: The 'Extinction' That Was Triggered by a Solar Flare—From Another Star
hook: A nearby star erupted 65 million years ago, bathing Earth in radiation—exactly when the dinosaurs died. Coincidence?
why_this_can_go_viral: Challenges the asteroid theory—gives a scarier, stellar-based extinction narrative.

title: The 'Dark Matter' Bullet That Passed Through Earth in 2018
hook: A sudden gravitational anomaly swept through our planet—scientists detected a dark matter clump moving at 400 km/s.
why_this_can_go_viral: Invisible threat passing through our bodies—visceral and terrifying.

title: The Fermi Paradox 'Filter': Humanity Is a Cosmic Plague
hook: New exoplanet surveys show that all life we detect seems to go extinct within 10,000 years of developing radio—except us.
why_this_can_go_viral: Horrifying twist on Fermi—we might be the disease the universe is hiding from.

title: The 'Signal' That Was a Warning About a Planet-Sized Object Entering Our Solar System
hook: A radio burst from beyond Pluto decoded to a simple message: 'It follows. It is near. It feeds.' Then the source went dark.
why_this_can_go_viral: Imminent threat + cryptic message = perfect viral horror content.

title: The Classified 'Program' That Mapped the Entire Solar System—and Found a Wall at the Edge
hook: A secret NASA program in the 1980s used gravity mapping to detect a 3000-km-thick 'wall' at the heliopause. The data was locked.
why_this_can_go_viral: Classified + physical barrier at edge of system—feels like a cosmic prison.

title: The 'Rogue Planet' That Travels Backward Through the Milky Way
hook: A Jupiter-sized planet is moving opposite to the galaxy's rotation—it's a wanderer ejected from its system, now hunting alone.
why_this_can_go_viral: Lone, rogue planet moving opposite to everything else—creates a sense of danger and aloneness.

title: The 'Asteroid' That Carved a 500-km Trench on Mars—In One Second
hook: An asteroid hit Mars with such force it carved a canyon deeper than the Grand Canyon in under a second—and we saw it happen.
why_this_can_go_viral: Scale + speed is mind-blowing—makes you imagine what that would do to Earth.

title: The Dark Matter 'Mass' That Caused the Moon to Drift 10 cm in 24 Hours
hook: Over a single day, the moon's orbit shifted—scientists blamed a clump of dark matter passing between Earth and its satellite.
why_this_can_go_viral: Tangible effect on the moon makes dark matter feel immediate and scary.

title: The Classified 'Program' That Wanted to Nuke a Comet—And Almost Did
hook: In 1998, a secret project planned to detonate a nuclear warhead on a comet to test planetary defense. The UN killed it—but the comet passed anyway.
why_this_can_go_viral: Government plan to nuke a comet—feels like a sci-fi thriller that almost happened.

title: The 'Extinction Event' That Was Caused by a Failed Star's Magnetic Pulse
hook: A brown dwarf passed close to Earth 12,000 years ago—its magnetic field stripped our atmosphere, triggering a mini ice age.
why_this_can_go_viral: A 'failed star' causing extinction—underappreciated threat that feels new and scary.

title: The 'Ghost Galaxy' That Sends Light That Never Ages
hook: A galaxy emits light that doesn't redshift—it's as if the photons are frozen in time, defying the expansion of the universe.
why_this_can_go_viral: Breaks fundamental physics—frozen light is a mind-bending concept.

title: The 'Asteroid' That Changed Color to Avoid Detection—And It Worked
hook: An asteroid near Earth went from dark red to bright blue in days—absorbing light differently, as if hiding from our telescopes.
why_this_can_go_viral: An object that 'hides' deliberately—implies intelligence and threat.
